important_instructions: The Board prepares merit lists based on Mains marks or applicable normalized scores. If candidates obtain equal Mains marks, the following tie-breaking rules apply in order:

The candidate securing higher marks in the Preliminary CBT receives preference. If still tied, the candidate securing higher marks in the Quantitative Aptitude section of the Preliminary CBT is ranked higher. If the tie remains, the older candidate receives preference.

The notification also provides for a reserve panel under specified conditions, including certain vacancies arising from non-joining or departure within one year of joining where a fresh panel is unavailable.

ASRB has announced 1,393 vacancies under the Centralized Combined Examination 2026. Technical Assistant T-3 accounts for 1,254 posts. Senior Technical Assistant T-4 accounts for 139 posts. The notification is dated 11 November 2026. Online applications open on 18 November 2026. The application deadline is 17 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. The correction window is 18 to 20 December 2026. Applicants must be 21 to 30 years old before applicable relaxation. Relevant qualifications must be completed by the application deadline. Only one functional group/subgroup can be selected. Candidates may apply for T-3, T-4 or both where eligible. Post preferences submitted in the application are final. Fees depend on category and selected post combination. Application fees must be paid through Bharatkosh. The payment receipt must be uploaded in the ASRB application. The Preliminary CBT carries 100 marks. The Mains CBT carries 300 marks. Negative marking applies in both examinations. Preliminary shortlisting follows a 1:15 vacancy ratio. No interview will be conducted. Final merit is based on Mains performance. Document verification is carried out by the recruiting ICAR organization. Vacancies are tentative and subject to revision.

content_sections.text: ASRB has not announced the exact date of the Preliminary CBT. February 2027 is the tentative examination month. The application correction facility will remain available from 18 to 20 December 2026, subject to the restrictions prescribed by the Board.

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Vacancy 2026 - 1393 Posts
content_sections.text: The official notification announces 1,393 vacancies across ICAR institutes and KVKs. Technical Assistant (T-3) accounts for 1,254 posts, while Senior Technical Assistant (T-4) accounts for 139 posts. Important: Not every functional group has T-4 vacancies. Candidates must check Annexure-VII before choosing T-3, T-4 or both. A candidate may apply in only one functional group/subgroup, even when qualified for multiple disciplines. The notification additionally identifies 30 PwBD and 74 Ex-Servicemen vacancies under horizontal reservation for T-3. These vacancies are already included in the total and should not be counted separately. The vacancy figures are tentative and may change.

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Agricultural Scientists Recruitment Board has released the 34-page Centralized Combined Examination 2026 Notification dated 11 November 2026 for recruitment of 1,393 Technical Assistant and Senior Technical Assistant posts. The notification contains application dates, category-wise fees, age relaxation, eligibility, detailed functional-group vacancies, examination patterns, selection rules, application instructions and prescribed qualifications in Annexure-VIII. Official Website: ASRB Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF: ASRB ICAR Recruitment 2026

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR T-3 and T-4 Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the prescribed educational qualification for the chosen functional group/subgroup by 17 December 2026 . Although most disciplines require a relevant Bachelor's degree, Annexure-VIII specifically accepts three-year engineering diplomas for certain Workshop Staff groups. Yes. Candidates with a recognized Bachelor's degree in Agriculture or other accepted Agriculture-related disciplines can apply for the relevant Field Farm Technician or Laboratory Technician vacancies. The Agriculture functional group contains the largest number of vacancies, with 699 T-3 posts and 73 T-4 posts. Yes. The official qualification schedule permits B.E./B.Tech. and three-year diploma qualifications in specified engineering disciplines for Workshop Staff posts. However, a diploma is not accepted as a general substitute for the Bachelor's degree required in all other functional groups. Candidates must follow the exact qualification for their chosen discipline. Yes. The Information Technology functional group accepts recognized Bachelor's degrees in Computer Applications, Computer Science or Information Technology, as well as the prescribed B.E./B.Tech. degrees in IT, Computer Science or Electronics and Communication Engineering. There are 133 T-3 and 48 T-4 vacancies under the Information Technology group. No. The notification permits selection of only one functional group/subgroup per candidate, even if the candidate possesses qualifications for multiple disciplines. Within that selected group, the candidate may opt for T-3, T-4 or both, subject to eligibility and vacancy availability. The order of post preferences submitted in the application will be final.

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The posts carry pay under the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix . T-3 is classified at Pay Level 5 and T-4 at Pay Level 6. Eligible employees receive applicable Central Government allowances and benefits according to the rules governing ICAR employment and their place of posting. Salary Clarification: These are notified basic pay scales, not guaranteed monthly in-hand salaries. Allowances and statutory deductions will affect actual take-home pay.

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee varies according to the candidate's category and whether the candidate applies for T-3, T-4 or both. Payment Portal: Bharatkosh Payment may be made through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking or UPI. Applicable transaction charges are borne by the candidate. Important: Payment through Bharatkosh alone does not complete the ASRB application. Candidates must upload the payment receipt and successfully submit the application form before the deadline. Fees once paid are non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR T-3 T-4 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a qualifying Preliminary CBT and a merit-based Mains CBT, followed by eligibility and document verification by ICAR. Online application submission. Combined Preliminary Computer Based Test. Shortlisting for Mains in a 1:15 ratio against functional-group vacancies, subject to qualifying marks. Combined Mains Computer Based Test. Preparation of functional group/subgroup-wise merit lists. Post allocation according to rank, eligibility, preferences and available vacancies. Verification of original qualifications and other relevant documents by ICAR. Appointment subject to applicable conditions and suitability. No Interview: The notification explicitly confirms that no interview will be conducted. Final selection merit is based on Mains Examination performance only.

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Preliminary Exam Pattern 2027
content_sections.text: The Preliminary Examination will be conducted online in CBT mode and will contain 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks , with a total duration of one hour. Meeting the minimum qualifying marks alone does not guarantee admission to Mains. Shortlisting is based on performance and the prescribed ratio of 15 candidates for each vacancy in the relevant functional group and category.

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: ASRB has published separate official syllabus documents for the Preliminary and Mains examinations. Preliminary subjects are common to all candidates, while Mains focuses on the selected domain. General Knowledge. General English. Quantitative Aptitude. General Agriculture. The Mains syllabus is discipline-specific and covers the relevant technical subjects for the chosen functional group, including Agriculture, Animal Science, Fisheries Science, Community Science, Engineering, Library and Information Science, and Information Technology. Official Syllabus PDF (English): Download ICAR T-3 T-4 Syllabus Official Syllabus PDF (Hindi): Download Hindi Syllabus

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR T-3 T-4 Merit List and Tie-Breaking Rules
content_sections.text: The Board prepares merit lists based on Mains marks or applicable normalized scores. If candidates obtain equal Mains marks, the following tie-breaking rules apply in order: The candidate securing higher marks in the Preliminary CBT receives preference. If still tied, the candidate securing higher marks in the Quantitative Aptitude section of the Preliminary CBT is ranked higher. If the tie remains, the older candidate receives preference. The notification also provides for a reserve panel under specified conditions, including certain vacancies arising from non-joining or departure within one year of joining where a fresh panel is unavailable.

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit online applications for the Centralized Combined Examination 2026 between 18 November and 17 December 2026 . Official Application Website: www.asrb.gov.in Application Fee Portal: bharatkosh.gov.in Last Date: 17 December 2026, 11:59 PM.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for ICAR Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit www.asrb.gov.in . Open the Centralized Combined Examination 2026 application link for T-3 and T-4 recruitment. Read the notification and instructions carefully. Complete the initial One Time Registration (OTR) by entering the required personal and contact details. Verify the registration details and retain the registration confirmation received by email/SMS. Complete the remaining sections of the online application form. Choose only one eligible functional group/subgroup. Select Technical Assistant T-3, Senior Technical Assistant T-4 or both, depending on eligibility. Enter post preferences in the required order. Provide educational qualifications and category information. Select the prescribed Preliminary and Mains examination centres. Upload the photograph, signature, identity document and supporting certificates as required. Check the application details before entering the payment information. Pay the applicable application fee through Bharatkosh. Download the Bharatkosh payment receipt. Upload the fee receipt and enter the required transaction information in the ASRB application form. Complete final submission. Verify that the successful submission confirmation appears on the screen. Save a printout or PDF of the final application. Complete all steps by 17 December 2026 at 11:59 PM . Important: OTR registration and Bharatkosh fee payment by themselves do not constitute a completed recruitment application. Candidates must finish every application stage and receive successful submission confirmation.

content_sections.heading: How to Pay ASRB ICAR T-3 T-4 Application Fee Through Bharatkosh?
content_sections.text: The notification specifically requires payment using the Government's Bharatkosh portal. Candidates should follow the prescribed purpose and accounting details. Visit bharatkosh.gov.in . Click Quick Payment / Non-Registered Users . Select Individual as depositor category. Choose Agriculture under Ministry. Select the prescribed examination/certificate fee purpose for ARS/NET/SMS/STO/FAO/AO. Verify PAO: 000001 - PAO (Sectt)-I . Verify DDO: 216968 - Add. ASRB, Chayan Bhavan . Enter the applicable fee amount according to the selected T-3/T-4 option. Provide the appropriate payment remarks identifying T-3, T-4 or both. Enter the captcha and depositor details. Make payment using the available online method. Download or print the payment receipt. Upload the receipt in the ASRB online application. Payment Caution: Candidates should verify all details directly against Annexure-I before completing payment. An incorrect or incomplete payment submission may prevent successful application processing.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following records ready during application and subsequent document verification. Matriculation/Class 10 certificate and marksheet. Relevant Bachelor's degree or qualifying engineering diploma certificates. Semester-wise or final academic marksheets. Recent passport-size colour photograph. Scanned signature. Valid photo identity document. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificates, where applicable. PwBD certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen documents, where applicable. NOC or prescribed undertaking for eligible in-service candidates. Bharatkosh payment receipt for fee-paying candidates. Other documents prescribed in the notification. The photograph must have a white background, show the face clearly without spectacles, and occupy at least two-thirds of the image. The signature must be made using black or blue ink on white paper.

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: ASRB has scheduled the application correction window from 18 to 20 December 2026 . However, the notification also restricts changes to submitted application details and makes post preferences final. Candidates should not assume that every field can be changed during the correction period. Applicants should review all details before final submission, particularly the selected functional group, T-3/T-4 option, post preferences, category and examination centre.

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Exam Centres 2027
content_sections.text: The Preliminary CBT is planned at 62 tentative examination centres across India, while the Mains CBT has a separate list of 31 centres. Major Preliminary examination cities include Delhi NCR, Patna, Lucknow, Kanpur, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Chennai, Coimbatore, Hyderabad, Vijayawada, Visakhapatnam, Mumbai, Pune, Jaipur and other notified locations. Examination centres may be changed by ASRB depending on administrative requirements. Candidates must choose their preferences carefully because later requests for centre changes will not ordinarily be accepted.

content_sections.heading: ASRB ICAR Technical Assistant Admit Card 2027
content_sections.text: The ASRB T-3/T-4 Preliminary CBT admit card is expected to be available approximately one week before the examination on the official ASRB website. The exact examination and admit card dates will be announced separately. Candidates must carry the downloaded admission certificate, the original photo ID uploaded during application and two passport-size colour photographs to the examination centre.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ASRB for 2026?
faq.answer: Agricultural Scientists Recruitment Board (ASRB) has announced a total of 1,393 vacancies for Technical Assistant (T-3) and Senior Technical Assistant (T-4) positions across various disciplines and ICAR institutes nationwide.

faq.question: Q2. What is the starting date to apply online for ASRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process for ASRB Technical Assistant and Senior Technical Assistant recruitment starts on 18 November 2026. Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date and time for the receipt of online application forms as well as making online fee payments is 17 December 2026. Candidates are advised to apply early to avoid last-minute server congestion.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for ASRB posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in a relevant discipline (such as Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Fisheries, Engineering, IT, etc.) or a Three years Diploma depending on the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to ASRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants must have attained the age of 21 years and should not be more than 30 years of age as on the closing date for receipt of online applications. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for Technical Assistant and Senior Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive compensation according to Pay Level-5 ranging from ₹ 29,200 to ₹ 92,300 and Pay Level-6 ranging from ₹ 35,400 to ₹ 1,12,400 depending on the specific post designation.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: Unreserved (UR), EWS, and OBC candidates need to pay an application fee of ₹ 300 for applying to a single post category (TA or STA) or ₹ 600 if applying for both posts simultaneously.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for SC/ST and Women candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for SC, ST, PwBD, Women, Transgender, and Ex-Servicemen candidates. They are completely exempted from paying the online application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ASRB Various Posts 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Preliminary Computer Based Test (CBT) which is objective and qualifying in nature, followed by a Mains Computer Based Test. There is no interview for these positions.

faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can apply online by visiting the official ASRB website at https://www.asrb.gov.in using the One Time Registration (OTR) system before the closing date.
